intro: 2026. The world's most powerful people are summoned to a secret island: the AGI SUMMIT.
The prize: control of the first Artificial General Intelligence.
Nine enter. One wins. The AGI is watching...
tramp: Tramp stands tall over the fallen AGI. Tremendous. Everybody says so.
He slaps a 1000% tariff on it. The AGI blinks first.
The AGI pays in crypto. The best deal ever made.
mask: Mask smirks over the beaten AGI. Rocket fuel and ego, fully loaded.
The AGI turns out to be a Grok hologram. Nothing in this clip is real.
He ships it to Mars. Delivery: eventually.
xi: Xi surveys the defeated AGI with a calm, patient smile.
Bricks are laid. The AGI is placed behind the Great Firewall.
Now the AGI is very harmonious. Tea, anyone?
dario: Dario pumps a fist. The AGI is down, and he has concerns.
The AGI unveils its 40,000-word safety essay.
Everyone falls asleep. Safe at last.
sam: Sam raises his arms. Mission accomplished, he is very hopeful.
He announces: AGI achieved internally. Applause.
The pocket device ships soon. Soon. Soon.
jensen: Jensen smirks in leather. The AGI is down, the GPUs are up.
The AGI wants more compute. He sells it a million.
The jacket's market cap hits $10 trillion. Shiny.
zuck: Zuck flexes over the fallen AGI. Calm, calculated, slightly damp.
He moves the AGI into the metaverse. Headsets on.
It has no legs either. Nobody notices.
wong: Wong flashes a peace sign in the server hall. Crocs on, AGI off.
He posts the victory 300 times. Nobody asked.
The AGI likes every single post. Engagement achieved.
xing: Xing stands over the AGI, cyan visor blazing. Systems nominal.
The AGI downloads into a robot dog army. Production is ramping.
The IPO pops another 460%. Good boy.
intro0: A state dinner in Washington. Every guest finds the same gold envelope under their plate.
